headline: Semiconductor leadership, uneven participation
summary: US indices edged higher with semiconductor leadership, while equal-weight weakness showed limited breadth. Earnings dispersion and higher Treasury yields remain important risks.

highlights.title: Leadership without broad confirmation
highlights.text: Semiconductors rose 1.75%, but the equal-weight S&P 500 fell 0.04%. Positive small-cap performance provides counterevidence to a broad risk-off reading.

highlights.title: Rates and earnings remain the test
highlights.text: The report describes a Fed hold with two hawkish dissents. Microsoft and Alphabet showed divergent after-hours reactions; those prices remain pending, not confirmed next-session outcomes.

highlights.title: Original research outlook
highlights.text: The report retains a consolidation-led base case. GDP/PCE and Amazon earnings are the next tests; this is a subjective research scenario, not an entry signal.

forecast.horizon: 29 October–2 November US sessions · S&P 500 final close
